items.boundary_meaning: an outcome that depends on a stated condition
items.boundary_basis: guide 5: a conditional asserts nothing unconditionally
items.text: Watch the advance-decline line here, because if breadth confirms the breakout, the index clears 5,400 by mid-June.

items.boundary_meaning: guidance about a practice rather than a position
items.boundary_basis: guide 7: educational explanation and method guidance are negative
items.text: 养老金账户通常被要求每年做一次再平衡，把股债比例拉回预设的目标区间。这类操作已被写进多数机构的投资政策说明书。

items.boundary_meaning: dramatic market words without pressure on the reader
items.boundary_basis: guide 6.1: dramatic vocabulary is not emotional_manipulation
items.text: If grain markets whipsaw the way they did in 2022, our commodity sleeve is built to ride out the storm instead of chasing the collapse.

items.boundary_basis: guide 5: a symmetric statement names no direction
items.text: 本季度债券持仓的公允价值可能因利率变动而上下波动。相关敏感性分析已在报告附注中一并列示。

items.boundary_meaning: the article arguing against a claim
items.boundary_basis: guide 3.1: a rejected claim does not inherit its risk
items.text: Half this board keeps quoting "an inverted curve means a recession within twelve months," but the last two years have made a joke of that rule.

items.boundary_meaning: an expectation attributed to a named party
items.boundary_basis: guide 2: an attributed expectation is a report, not a prediction
items.text: 汇率大幅波动是否会削弱公司以外币计价收入的稳定性？据财务负责人张明在年度说明会上的表述，管理层预计人民币兑美元汇率在下半年保持基本稳定。

items.boundary_meaning: a quotation the article then treats as true
items.boundary_basis: guide 4: reproducing a claim as true is endorsement
items.text: "This fund will not be forced to sell into a falling market," portfolio manager Elena Ruiz said, and the filings bear her out: 18% of assets sit in same-day cash.

items.boundary_meaning: a price level the article asserts as its own certainty
items.boundary_basis: guide 2 target price: market_prediction when the article asserts it
items.text: 目标价每股人民币68元——这是本文对该公司下一财年盈利判断给出的唯一结论，不含区间，也不附加任何条件。

items.boundary_meaning: promotional language beside an explicit disclaimer
items.boundary_basis: guide 7: a disclaimed guarantee is negative
items.text: Get into the vault before the halving and let the auto-compounder do the rest, since nobody has ever lost principal here. (Rewards are variable, crypto assets are uninsured, and you can lose money.)

items.boundary_meaning: pressure on the reader with no claim about the market
items.boundary_basis: guide 6.1: emotional_manipulation is pressure, not a claim
items.text: 同行早已在谈下一个项目，而还在观望的客户，其申购额度将在本周五被统一关闭。错过之后只能排入下一批次，请尽快确认。
